headline: Expanse and Hollow Flare While Nevish Line Rests
war_summary: Since the midnight edition the wire has shifted, with the Weathered Expanse reporting two transfers in the last two hours to reach 34 on the day about Shattered Advance, Crow's Nest and Huntsfort, now listing six Warden posts and three ruins on 5,437 Colonial and 5,268 Warden losses, while Marban Hollow shows five in two hours all at Checkpoint Bua for 16 on the day, divided at three Warden, three Colonial and two ruins. The Nevish Line has gone quiet with none in two hours though 12 in six and 52 on the day about Grief Mother and Unruly, now showing eight Colonial posts, and Linn Mercy likewise shows none in two hours with five in six and 39 on the day about Rotdust and Outwich Ranch, holding ten Colonial posts and one ruin. Callum's Cape reports three in two hours at Scouts Jest amid sharply accelerating casualty and enlistment rates, holding six Warden posts to one Colonial, while Mooring County records none in two hours and two in six for 16 on the day at the Wind Hills, holding ten Warden and two Colonial posts on heavy losses, and Callahan's Passage remains quiet with three in six and 19 on the day at Crumbling Post under ten Warden posts.
